observations.humor_and_voices: The opening separates Heather’s carvings from the dogs’ café priorities. Neet mistakes guardians for a warning and checks whether the second lion is in charge; Buddy’s repeated checks of where not to look make his desire for seconds funny rather than merely censorious. His dignified second piece disappearing before the wipe finishes pays off that plan. Neet’s one-paw-at-a-time innocence and Buddy becoming tempted by his own guarded jalebi build a second comic reversal. Heather’s calm spice intervention and amused permission to return are distinct from either dog.
observations.cause_effect_and_pacing: Tour leads to meal, greedy eating to spice crisis and cleaning, patience to Buddy’s extra roti, attempted theft to paw restraint and fafda, then return travel. Short paragraphs and three scene-specific illustrations preserve dialogue order. Dish lists give food specificity; the final ride has no image interruption.

image_placement.finding: After real-lions-ahead alarm and before the second-lion check: two visible carved lions make the coming check plausible, Neet looks up alarmed and Buddy stays steady. His lowered paw is compatible with the subsequent spoken reaction after pointing, not a contradictory frozen gesture. Architectural scale establishes the setting.

After wearing-more-food line, before spice and wiping: dal/mango mess remains on Neet, clean Buddy keeps roti on a separate plate, seated bench/table composition delivers the restrained-versus-messy contrast. No premature cleaning or spice pantomime.

After explicit paw stop, before Neet’s interrupted plea and fafda reward: Buddy’s pale paw overlaps Neet’s reaching tan paw on stool, open jalebi box is behind contact, Heather faces payment counter, Neet is clean following wipe. Three other supported limbs per dog are readable at this size. Scene provides physical action rather than another seated portrait.

observations.payoff: Symbolic protection returns as Buddy guarding the closed snack bag; Neet lies down and the jalebi travels undisturbed. The action turns an opening misunderstanding into earned affectionate restraint, with Try me as Buddy’s own final comic choice.
